text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Ace-san! Just wait until 
you see the feast I'm making!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san and I prepared a whole lot for 
you. We used tons of the carrots we grew 
ourselves using the farming tips Ace-san 
taught us!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, thanks! I've got high hopes for 
this!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—...And then once it actually starts, 
Spe'll probably just gobble it all up, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Whaaat?! No, no, there's no way 
that's true!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even if Spe-san starts digging in, we'll 
be fine! I've prepared more than enough 
food!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! I'm only joking! No, actually, 
please do that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Eat up, both of you. Eat hearty. And grow 
big and strong!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to it, you 
know. To seeing all of youâcatch up 
right behind me!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you very much. But today's feast 
is a present from us to you!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oops, you're right! There's no point if I 
don't eat too. ...Thanks!
